queries: SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance) AS attendance_share FROM member AS m JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position ORDER BY attendance_share DESC, m.member_id LIMIT 10;
